stem: Find the values of \(x\) and \(y\) using the information shown in figure 3.37. Find the measure of \(\angle ABD\) and \(m\angle ACD\). [In figure 3.37, point A lies above seg BC and point D lies below it, and seg BC is drawn. Seg AB and seg AC each carry a double tick mark, so \(AB \cong AC\); seg BD and seg CD each carry a single tick mark, so \(BD \cong CD\). At vertex B, the angle above seg BC is \(\angle ABC = x\) and the angle below seg BC is \(\angle DBC = 60^\circ\). At vertex C, the angle above seg BC is \(\angle ACB = 50^\circ\) and the angle below seg BC is \(\angle DCB = y\).]
diagramNote: Fig. 3.37 — kite-shaped figure ABDC with diagonal seg BC drawn: A on top, D at the bottom. Double ticks on AB and AC, single ticks on BD and CD. At B the upper angle is labelled x and the lower angle 60 degrees; at C the upper angle is 50 degrees and the lower angle is labelled y.
